versos.grego: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἀπῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς Γαλιλαίας τῆς Τιβεριάδος.

controles.web: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.
controles.kjv: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
controles.livre: Depois disto Jesus partiu para a outro lado do mar da Galileia, que é o de Tibérias.

versos.grego: ἠκολούθει δὲ αὐτῷ ὄχλος πολύς, ὅτι ἑώρων τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐποίει ἐπὶ τῶν ἀσθενούντων.

controles.web: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.
controles.kjv: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
controles.livre: E uma grande multidão o seguia, porque viam seus sinais que ele fazia nos enfermos.

versos.grego: ἀνῆλθεν δὲ εἰς τὸ ὄρος Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἐκεῖ ἐκάθητο μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.
controles.kjv: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
controles.livre: E subiu Jesus ao monte, e sentou-se ali com seus discípulos.

versos.grego: ἦν δὲ ἐγγὺς τὸ πάσχα, ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων.

controles.web: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
controles.kjv: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
controles.livre: E já a Páscoa, a festa dos judeus, estava perto.

versos.grego: ἐπάρας οὖν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ θεασάμενος ὅτι πολὺς ὄχλος ἔρχεται πρὸς αὐτὸν, λέγει πρὸς Φίλιππον Πόθεν ἀγοράσωμεν ἄρτους ἵνα φάγωσιν οὗτοι;

controles.web: Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”
controles.kjv: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
controles.livre: Levantando pois Jesus os olhos, e vendo que uma grande multidão vinha a ele, disse a Filipe: De onde comparemos pães, para que estes comam?

versos.grego: τοῦτο δὲ ἔλεγεν πειράζων αὐτόν· αὐτὸς γὰρ ᾔδει τί ἔμελλεν ποιεῖν.

controles.web: This he said to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.
controles.kjv: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
controles.livre: (Mas ele disse isto para o testar; pois ele bem sabia o que havia de fazer.)

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ ὁ Φίλιππος Διακοσίων δηναρίων ἄρτοι οὐκ ἀρκοῦσιν αὐτοῖς, ἵνα ἕκαστος βραχύ τι λάβῃ.

controles.web: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that everyone of them may receive a little.”
controles.kjv: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
controles.livre: Respondeu-lhe Filipe: Duzentos dinheiros de pão não lhes bastarão, para que cada um deles tome um pouco.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῷ εἷς ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ, Ἀνδρέας ὁ ἀδελφὸς Σίμωνος Πέτρου

controles.web: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,
controles.kjv: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, saith unto him,
controles.livre: Disse-lhe um de seus discípulos, André, o irmão de Simão Pedro:

versos.grego: Ἔστιν παιδάριον ὧδε ὃς ἔχει πέντε ἄρτους κριθίνους καὶ δύο ὀψάρια· ἀλλὰ ταῦτα τί ἐστιν εἰς τοσούτους;

controles.web: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”
controles.kjv: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
controles.livre: Um menino está aqui que tem cinco pães de cevada e dois peixinhos; mas que é isto entre tantos?

versos.grego: εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ποιήσατε τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἀναπεσεῖν. ἦν δὲ χόρτος πολὺς ἐν τῷ τόπῳ. ἀνέπεσαν οὖν οἱ ἄνδρες τὸν ἀριθμὸν ὡς πεντακισχίλιοι.

controles.web: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
controles.kjv: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
controles.livre: E disse Jesus: Fazei sentar as pessoas; e havia muita erva naquele lugar. Sentaram-se, pois, os homens, em número de cinco mil.

versos.grego: ἔλαβεν οὖν τοὺς ἄρτους ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εὐχαριστήσας διέδωκεν τοῖς ἀνακειμένοις, ὁμοίως καὶ ἐκ τῶν ὀψαρίων ὅσον ἤθελον.

controles.web: Jesus took the loaves; and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down; likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.
controles.kjv: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
controles.livre: E tomou Jesus os pães, e havendo dado graças, repartiu-os aos discípulos, e os discípulos aos que estavam sentados, semelhantemente também dos peixes, quanto queriam.

versos.grego: ὡς δὲ ἐνεπλήσθησαν, λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ Συναγάγετε τὰ περισσεύσαντα κλάσματα, ἵνα μή τι ἀπόληται.

controles.web: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”
controles.kjv: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
controles.livre: E quando já estiveram fartos, disse ele a seus discípulos: Recolhei os pedaços que sobraram, para que nada se perca.

versos.grego: συνήγαγον οὖν, καὶ ἐγέμισαν δώδεκα κοφίνους κλασμάτων ἐκ τῶν πέντε ἄρτων τῶν κριθίνων ἃ ἐπερίσσευσαν τοῖς βεβρωκόσιν.

controles.web: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.
controles.kjv: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
controles.livre: Então eles os recolheram, e encheram doze cestos de pedaços dos cinco pães de cevada, que sobraram aos que tinham comido.

versos.grego: Οἱ οὖν ἄνθρωποι ἰδόντες ὃ ἐποίησεν σημεῖον ἔλεγον ὅτι Οὗτός ἐστιν ἀληθῶς ὁ προφήτης ὁ ἐρχόμενος εἰς τὸν κόσμον.

controles.web: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”
controles.kjv: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
controles.livre: Vendo, pois, aquelas pessoas o sinal que Jesus fizera, disseram: Este é verdadeiramente o Profeta que havia de vir ao mundo!

versos.grego: Ἰησοῦς οὖν γνοὺς ὅτι μέλλουσιν ἔρχεσθαι καὶ ἁρπάζειν αὐτὸν ἵνα ποιήσωσιν βασιλέα, ἀνεχώρησεν πάλιν εἰς τὸ ὄρος αὐτὸς μόνος.

controles.web: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force, to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
controles.kjv: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
controles.livre: Sabendo pois Jesus que viriam, e o tomariam, para fazê-lo rei, voltou a se retirar sozinho ao monte.

versos.grego: Ὡς δὲ ὀψία ἐγένετο, κατέβησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν,

controles.web: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea,
controles.kjv: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
controles.livre: E quando veio o entardecer, seus discípulos desceram para o mar.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐμβάντες εἰς πλοῖον ἤρχοντο πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης εἰς Καφαρναούμ. καὶ σκοτία ἤδη ἐγεγόνει καὶ οὔπω ἐληλύθει πρὸς αὐτοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς,

controles.web: and they entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
controles.kjv: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
controles.livre: E entrando no barco, vieram do outro lado do mar para Cafarnaum. E era já escuro, e Jesus ainda não tinha vindo a eles.

versos.grego: ἥ τε θάλασσα ἀνέμου μεγάλου πνέοντος διεγείρετο.

controles.web: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.
controles.kjv: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
controles.livre: E o mar se levantou, porque um grande vento soprava.

versos.grego: ἐληλακότες οὖν ὡς σταδίους εἴκοσι πέντε ἢ τριάκοντα θεωροῦσιν τὸν Ἰησοῦν περιπατοῦντα ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ ἐγγὺς τοῦ πλοίου γινόμενον, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν.

controles.web: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia,  they saw Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.
controles.kjv: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
controles.livre: E havendo já navegado quase vinte e cinco, ou trinta estádios, viram a Jesus andando sobre o mar, e se aproximando do barco; e temeram.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἐγώ εἰμι, μὴ φοβεῖσθε.

controles.web: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
controles.kjv: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
controles.livre: Mas ele lhes disse: Sou eu, não temais.

versos.grego: ἤθελον οὖν λαβεῖν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον, καὶ εὐθέως ἐγένετο τὸ πλοῖον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἰς ἣν ὑπῆγον.

controles.web: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
controles.kjv: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
controles.livre: Eles, então, o receberam com agrado no barco; e logo o barco chegou à terra para onde iam.

versos.grego: Τῇ ἐπαύριον ὁ ὄχλος ὁ ἑστηκὼς πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης εἶδον ὅτι πλοιάριον ἄλλο οὐκ ἦν ἐκεῖ εἰ μὴ ἕν, καὶ ὅτι οὐ συνεισῆλθεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸ πλοῖον ἀλλὰ μόνοι οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθον·

controles.web: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.
controles.kjv: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
controles.livre: O dia seguinte, vendo a multidão, que estava do outro lado do mar, que não havia ali mais que um barquinho, em que seus discípulos entraram; e que Jesus não entrara com seus discípulos naquele barquinho, mas que seus discípulos sós se haviam ido;

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ ἦλθεν πλοιάρια ἐκ Τιβεριάδος ἐγγὺς τοῦ τόπου ὅπου ἔφαγον τὸν ἄρτον εὐχαριστήσαντος τοῦ Κυρίου.

controles.web: However boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
controles.kjv: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
controles.livre: (Porém outros barquinhos vieram de Tibérias, perto do lugar onde comeram o pão, havendo o Senhor dado graças.)

versos.grego: ὅτε οὖν εἶδεν ὁ ὄχλος ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκεῖ οὐδὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ, ἐνέβησαν αὐτοὶ εἰς τὰ πλοιάρια καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ ζητοῦντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

controles.web: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats, and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
controles.kjv: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
controles.livre: Vendo pois a multidão que Jesus não estava ali, nem seus discípulos, entraram eles também nos barcos, e vieram a Cafarnaum em busca de Jesus.

versos.grego: καὶ εὑρόντες αὐτὸν πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης εἶπον αὐτῷ Ῥαββεί, πότε ὧδε γέγονας;

controles.web: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”
controles.kjv: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
controles.livre: E achando-o do outro lado do mar, disseram: Rabi, quando chegaste aqui?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ζητεῖτέ με οὐχ ὅτι εἴδετε σημεῖα, ἀλλ’ ὅτι ἐφάγετε ἐκ τῶν ἄρτων καὶ ἐχορτάσθητε.

controles.web: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves, and were filled.
controles.kjv: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
controles.livre: Respondeu-lhes Jesus, e disse: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que me buscais, não pelos sinais que vistes, mas pelo pão que comestes, e vos fartastes.

versos.grego: ἐργάζεσθε μὴ τὴν βρῶσιν τὴν ἀπολλυμένην, ἀλλὰ τὴν βρῶσιν τὴν μένουσαν εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον, ἣν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὑμῖν δώσει· τοῦτον γὰρ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐσφράγισεν ὁ Θεός.

controles.web: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”
controles.kjv: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
controles.livre: Trabalhai não pela comida que perece, mas sim pela comida que permanece para vida eterna, a qual o Filho do homem vos dará; porque Deus Pai a este selou.

versos.grego: εἶπον οὖν πρὸς αὐτόν Τί ποιῶμεν ἵνα ἐργαζώμεθα τὰ ἔργα τοῦ Θεοῦ;

controles.web: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”
controles.kjv: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
controles.livre: Disseram-lhe pois: Que faremos, para trabalharmos as obras de Deus?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ ἔργον τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἵνα πιστεύητε εἰς ὃν ἀπέστειλεν ἐκεῖνος.

controles.web: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
controles.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
controles.livre: Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhes: Esta é a obra de Deus: que creiais naquele que ele enviou.

versos.grego: εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ Τί οὖν ποιεῖς σὺ σημεῖον, ἵνα ἴδωμεν καὶ πιστεύσωμέν σοι; τί ἐργάζῃ;

controles.web: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see, and believe you? What work do you do?
controles.kjv: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
controles.livre: Disseram-lhe pois: Que sinal, pois, fazes tu para que o vejamos, e em ti creiamos? O que tu operas?

versos.grego: οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν τὸ μάννα ἔφαγον ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, καθώς ἐστιν γεγραμμένον Ἄρτον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς φαγεῖν.

controles.web: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”
controles.kjv: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
controles.livre: Nossos pais comeram o maná no deserto, como está escrito: Pão do céu ele lhes deu para comer.

versos.grego: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐ Μωϋσῆς δέδωκεν ὑμῖν τὸν ἄρτον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, ἀλλ’ ὁ Πατήρ μου δίδωσιν ὑμῖν τὸν ἄρτον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τὸν ἀληθινόν·

controles.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.
controles.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
controles.livre: Então Jesus lhes disse: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que Moisés não vos deu o pão do céu; mas meu Pai vos dá o verdadeiro pão do céu.

versos.grego: ὁ γὰρ ἄρτος τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστιν ὁ καταβαίνων ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ζωὴν διδοὺς τῷ κόσμῳ.

controles.web: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven, and gives life to the world.”
controles.kjv: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
controles.livre: Porque o pão de Deus é aquele que desce do céu e dá vida ao mundo.

versos.grego: εἶπον οὖν πρὸς αὐτόν Κύριε, πάντοτε δὸς ἡμῖν τὸν ἄρτον τοῦτον.

controles.web: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”
controles.kjv: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
controles.livre: Disseram-lhe pois: Senhor, dá-nos sempre d este pão.

versos.grego: εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος τῆς ζωῆς· ὁ ἐρχόμενος πρὸς ἐμὲ οὐ μὴ πεινάσῃ, καὶ ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ μὴ διψήσει πώποτε.

controles.web: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will not be hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.
controles.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhes disse: Eu sou o pão da vida; quem vem a mim de maneira nenhuma terá fome, e quem crê em mim nunca terá sede.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ εἶπον ὑμῖν ὅτι καὶ ἑωράκατέ με καὶ οὐ πιστεύετε.

controles.web: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.
controles.kjv: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
controles.livre: Mas já tenho vos dito que também me vistes, e não credes.

versos.grego: Πᾶν ὃ δίδωσίν μοι ὁ Πατὴρ πρὸς ἐμὲ ἥξει, καὶ τὸν ἐρχόμενον πρός με οὐ μὴ ἐκβάλω ἔξω,

controles.web: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
controles.kjv: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
controles.livre: Tudo o que o Pai me dá virá a mim; e ao que vem a mim, em maneira nenhuma o lançarei fora.

versos.grego: ὅτι καταβέβηκα ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ οὐχ ἵνα ποιῶ τὸ θέλημα τὸ ἐμὸν ἀλλὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με.

controles.web: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
controles.kjv: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
controles.livre: Porque eu desci do céu, não para fazer minha vontade, mas sim a vontade daquele que me enviou;

versos.grego: τοῦτο δέ ἐστιν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με, ἵνα πᾶν ὃ δέδωκέν μοι μὴ ἀπολέσω ἐξ αὐτοῦ, ἀλλὰ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸ ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.

controles.web: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.
controles.kjv: And this is the Father’s will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
controles.livre: E esta é a vontade do Pai, que me enviou: que de tudo quanto me deu, nada perca, mas que eu o ressuscite no último dia.

versos.grego: τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Πατρός μου, ἵνα πᾶς ὁ θεωρῶν τὸν Υἱὸν καὶ πιστεύων εἰς αὐτὸν ἔχῃ ζωὴν αἰώνιον, καὶ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸν ἐγὼ ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.

controles.web: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son, and believes in him, should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”
controles.kjv: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
controles.livre: E esta é a vontade daquele que me enviou, que todo aquele que vê ao Filho, e nele crê, tenha a vida eterna; e eu o ressuscitarei no último dia.

versos.grego: Ἐγόγγυζον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι περὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι εἶπεν Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος ὁ καταβὰς ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ,

controles.web: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”
controles.kjv: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
controles.livre: Então os judeus murmuravam dele, porque ele tinha dito: Eu sou o pão que desceu do céu.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔλεγον Οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν Ἰησοῦς ὁ υἱὸς Ἰωσήφ, οὗ ἡμεῖς οἴδαμεν τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα; πῶς νῦν λέγει ὅτι Ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβέβηκα;

controles.web: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven?’”
controles.kjv: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
controles.livre: E diziam: Não é este Jesus o filho de José, cujos pai e mãe nós conhecemos? Como, pois, ele diz: Desci do céu?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Μὴ γογγύζετε μετ’ ἀλλήλων.

controles.web: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.
controles.kjv: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
controles.livre: Respondeu, então, Jesus, e disse-lhes: Não murmureis entre vós.

versos.grego: οὐδεὶς δύναται ἐλθεῖν πρός με ἐὰν μὴ ὁ Πατὴρ ὁ πέμψας με ἑλκύσῃ αὐτόν, κἀγὼ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.

controles.web: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up in the last day.
controles.kjv: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
controles.livre: Ninguém pode vir a mim se o Pai que me enviou não o trouxer; e eu o ressuscitarei no último dia.

versos.grego: ἔστιν γεγραμμένον ἐν τοῖς προφήταις Καὶ ἔσονται πάντες διδακτοὶ Θεοῦ· πᾶς ὁ ἀκούσας παρὰ τοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ μαθὼν ἔρχεται πρὸς ἐμέ.

controles.web: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’   Therefore everyone who hears from the Father, and has learned, comes to me.
controles.kjv: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
controles.livre: Escrito está nos profetas: E todos serão ensinados por Deus. Portanto todo aquele que do Pai ouviu e aprendeu, esse vem a mim.

versos.grego: οὐχ ὅτι τὸν Πατέρα ἑώρακέν τις, εἰ μὴ ὁ ὢν παρὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ, οὗτος ἑώρακεν τὸν Πατέρα.

controles.web: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.
controles.kjv: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.
controles.livre: Não que alguém tenha visto ao Pai, a não ser aquele que é de Deus; este tem visto ao Pai.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ πιστεύων ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

controles.web: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.
controles.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
controles.livre: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que aquele que crê  tem vida eterna.

versos.grego: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος τῆς ζωῆς.

controles.web: I am the bread of life.
controles.kjv: I am that bread of life.
controles.livre: Eu sou o pão da vida.

versos.grego: οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἔφαγον ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τὸ μάννα καὶ ἀπέθανον·

controles.web: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.
controles.kjv: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
controles.livre: Vossos pais comeram o maná no deserto, e morreram.

versos.grego: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἄρτος ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβαίνων, ἵνα τις ἐξ αὐτοῦ φάγῃ καὶ μὴ ἀποθάνῃ.

controles.web: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.
controles.kjv: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
controles.livre: Este é o pão que desceu do céu, para que o ser humano coma dele e não morra.

versos.grego: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος ὁ ζῶν ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβάς· ἐάν τις φάγῃ ἐκ τούτου τοῦ ἄρτου, ζήσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· καὶ ὁ ἄρτος δὲ ὃν ἐγὼ δώσω ἡ σάρξ μού ἐστιν ὑπὲρ τῆς τοῦ κόσμου ζωῆς.

controles.web: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”
controles.kjv: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
controles.livre: Eu sou o pão vivo, que desceu do céu; se alguém comer deste pão, para sempre viverá. E o pão que eu darei é minha carne, a qual darei pela vida do mundo.

versos.grego: Ἐμάχοντο οὖν πρὸς ἀλλήλους οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι λέγοντες Πῶς δύναται οὗτος ἡμῖν δοῦναι τὴν σάρκα φαγεῖν;

controles.web: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”
controles.kjv: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
controles.livre: Discutiam, pois, os Judeus entre si, dizendo: Como este pode nos dar sua carne para comer?

versos.grego: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν μὴ φάγητε τὴν σάρκα τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ πίητε αὐτοῦ τὸ αἷμα, οὐκ ἔχετε ζωὴν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς.

controles.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.
controles.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
controles.livre: Jesus, então, lhes disse: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que se não comerdes a carne do Filho do homem e beberdes seu sangue, não tereis vida em vós mesmos.

versos.grego: ὁ τρώγων μου τὴν σάρκα καὶ πίνων μου τὸ αἷμα ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον, κἀγὼ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.

controles.web: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
controles.kjv: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
controles.livre: Quem come minha carne e bebe meu sangue tem vida eterna, e eu o ressuscitarei no último dia.

versos.grego: ἡ γὰρ σάρξ μου ἀληθής ἐστιν βρῶσις, καὶ τὸ αἷμά μου ἀληθής ἐστιν πόσις.

controles.web: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
controles.kjv: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
controles.livre: Porque minha carne verdadeiramente é comida; e meu sangue verdadeiramente é bebida.

versos.grego: ὁ τρώγων μου τὴν σάρκα καὶ πίνων μου τὸ αἷμα ἐν ἐμοὶ μένει κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
controles.kjv: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
controles.livre: Quem come minha carne e bebe meu sangue, em mim permanece, e eu nele.

versos.grego: καθὼς ἀπέστειλέν με ὁ ζῶν Πατὴρ κἀγὼ ζῶ διὰ τὸν Πατέρα, καὶ ὁ τρώγων με κἀκεῖνος ζήσει δι’ ἐμέ.

controles.web: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so he who feeds on me, he will also live because of me.
controles.kjv: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
controles.livre: Como o Pai vivo me enviou, e eu vivo pelo Pai, assim quem come a mim também por mim viverá.

versos.grego: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἄρτος ὁ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ καταβάς, οὐ καθὼς ἔφαγον οἱ πατέρες καὶ ἀπέθανον· ὁ τρώγων τοῦτον τὸν ἄρτον ζήσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

controles.web: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna, and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”
controles.kjv: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
controles.livre: Este é o pão que desceu do céu. Não como vossos pais, que comeram o maná e morreram; quem comer este pão viverá para sempre.

versos.grego: Ταῦτα εἶπεν ἐν συναγωγῇ διδάσκων ἐν Καφαρναούμ.

controles.web: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
controles.kjv: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
controles.livre: Estas coisas ele disse na sinagoga, ensinando em Cafarnaum.

versos.grego: Πολλοὶ οὖν ἀκούσαντες ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ εἶπαν Σκληρός ἐστιν ὁ λόγος οὗτος· τίς δύναται αὐτοῦ ἀκούειν;

controles.web: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
controles.kjv: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
controles.livre: Muitos pois de seus discípulos, ao ouvirem isto , disseram: Dura é esta palavra; quem a pode ouvir?

versos.grego: εἰδὼς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν ἑαυτῷ ὅτι γογγύζουσιν περὶ τούτου οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ, εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τοῦτο ὑμᾶς σκανδαλίζει;

controles.web: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?
controles.kjv: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
controles.livre: Sabendo pois Jesus em si mesmo, que seus discípulos murmuravam disto, disse-lhes: Isto vos ofende?

versos.grego: ἐὰν οὖν θεωρῆτε τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἀναβαίνοντα ὅπου ἦν τὸ πρότερον;

controles.web: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
controles.kjv: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
controles.livre: Que seria pois, se vísseis ao Filho do homem subir aonde estava primeiro?

versos.grego: τὸ πνεῦμά ἐστιν τὸ ζωοποιοῦν, ἡ σὰρξ οὐκ ὠφελεῖ οὐδέν· τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἐγὼ λελάληκα ὑμῖν πνεῦμά ἐστιν καὶ ζωή ἐστιν.

controles.web: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
controles.kjv: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
controles.livre: O Espírito é o que vivifica, a carne para nada aproveita; as palavras que eu vos digo são espírito e são vida.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ εἰσὶν ἐξ ὑμῶν τινες οἳ οὐ πιστεύουσιν. ᾔδει γὰρ ἐξ ἀρχῆς ὁ Ἰησοῦς τίνες εἰσὶν οἱ μὴ πιστεύοντες καὶ τίς ἐστιν ὁ παραδώσων αὐτόν.

controles.web: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.
controles.kjv: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
controles.livre: Mas há alguns de vós que não creem.Porque Jesus já sabia desde o princípio quem eram os que não criam, e quem era o que o entregaria.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔλεγεν Διὰ τοῦτο εἴρηκα ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδεὶς δύναται ἐλθεῖν πρός με ἐὰν μὴ ᾖ δεδομένον αὐτῷ ἐκ τοῦ Πατρός.

controles.web: He said, “For this cause have I said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
controles.kjv: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
controles.livre: E dizia: Por isso tenho vos dito que ninguém pode vir a mim, se não lhe for concedido por meu Pai.

versos.grego: Ἐκ τούτου πολλοὶ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθον εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ οὐκέτι μετ’ αὐτοῦ περιεπάτουν.

controles.web: At this, many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
controles.kjv: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
controles.livre: Desde então muitos de seus discípulos voltaram atrás, e já não andavam com ele.

versos.grego: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς δώδεκα Μὴ καὶ ὑμεῖς θέλετε ὑπάγειν;

controles.web: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”
controles.kjv: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
controles.livre: Disse, então, Jesus aos doze: Por acaso também vós quereis ir?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Σίμων Πέτρος Κύριε, πρὸς τίνα ἀπελευσόμεθα; ῥήματα ζωῆς αἰωνίου ἔχεις·

controles.web: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
controles.kjv: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
controles.livre: Respondeu-lhe pois Simão Pedro: Senhor, a quem iremos? Tu tens as palavras da vida eterna;

versos.grego: καὶ ἡμεῖς πεπιστεύκαμεν καὶ ἐγνώκαμεν ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ Ἅγιος τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
controles.kjv: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
controles.livre: E nós cremos e conhecemos que tu és o Santo de Deus  .

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Οὐκ ἐγὼ ὑμᾶς τοὺς δώδεκα ἐξελεξάμην; καὶ ἐξ ὑμῶν εἷς διάβολός ἐστιν.

controles.web: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”
controles.kjv: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
controles.livre: Jesus lhes respondeu: Por acaso não fui eu que vos escolhi, os doze? Porém um de vós é um diabo.

versos.grego: ἔλεγεν δὲ τὸν Ἰούδαν Σίμωνος Ἰσκαριώτου· οὗτος γὰρ ἔμελλεν παραδιδόναι αὐτόν, εἷς ἐκ τῶν δώδεκα.

controles.web: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.
controles.kjv: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
controles.livre: E ele dizia isto de Judas de Simão Iscariotes; porque ele o entregaria, o qual era um dos doze.
